paragraphs: Yehudah Gerogeret: Yoma 78a, “Yehudah Gerogeret taught: one may not sit on mud on Yom Kippur.” R. Yehoshua ben Levi said: This applies to mud wet enough to moisten what touches it. Shabbat 108b: Yehudah Gerogeret taught. R. Chizkiyah said: R. Yehudah Gerogeret taught. Arukh explains it as a byname; The comment cited here as Tosafot, Yoma there, says Yehudah Gerogeret was his name. [It appears in Tosafot Yeshanim in the checked edition.]
